verdict.rationale: Render offers a managed Key Value datastore marketed as "low-latency in-memory storage ideal for shared caches and job queues." The CLI can open a redis-cli or valkey-cli session against Render Key Value instances, which indicates Redis/Valkey protocol compatibility. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party Key Value docs (explicit Redis-compatibility statement, plans, persistence, eviction or queue-library guidance) and independent or hands-on corroboration of latency and job-queue use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a Redis-compatible key-value store for low-latency caching and job queues

citations.quote: Low-latency in-memory storage ideal for shared caches and job queues.
Open a redis-cli or valkey-cli session for a Render Key Value instance.
The Render CLI can manage services, Render Postgres databases, and Render Key Value instances.
